customer_address_gstin.name: customer_address_gstin
customer_address_gstin.value: "customer_address"."gstin" is null or ("customer_address"."country_code" = 'IN' and "customer_address"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$' and left("customer_address"."gstin", 2) = "customer_address"."region_code")

pricing_price_list_dates_ordered.name: pricing_price_list_dates_ordered
pricing_price_list_dates_ordered.value: "pricing_price_list"."active_from" is null or "pricing_price_list"."active_until" is null or "pricing_price_list"."active_until" > "pricing_price_list"."active_from"

visibility_context_shape.name: visibility_context_shape
visibility_context_shape.value:
case "visibility_context"."target"
        when 'default' then "visibility_context"."website_id" is null and "visibility_context"."target_id" is null
        when 'website' then "visibility_context"."website_id" is not null and "visibility_context"."target_id" = "visibility_context"."website_id"
        else "visibility_context"."website_id" is not null and "visibility_context"."target_id" is not null end
